title: KV: shadow-threshold hysteresis and predictive spill mitigator
author: Marco Delgado
merge_details: Merged by Marco Delgado on main via squash: 1 squashed commit (commit id: d4f9c3a)
Post-merge release candidate run (canary) green in eu-west-1
description:
Motivation: The KV cache was showing oscillatory spill behaviour under mixed tenant workloads: hot tenants would momentarily exhaust reservation windows causing aggressive spill followed by immediate refill and repeated churn. This amplified fragmentation and increased tail latency for token-serving requests. This PR introduces a shadow-threshold mechanism with hysteresis and a lightweight predictive spill mitigator that smooths eviction decisions, reduces micro-spill events, and proactively consolidates cold fragments to reduce paging overhead.

Design summary: Implement a shadow reservation vector per tenant that tracks short-term access intensity (exponentially-weighted histogram over 1s/10s/60s windows). Eviction decisions consult both the live occupancy and the shadow vector: when the live occupancy crosses a threshold, the hysteresis band prevents immediate spill unless the shadow signal indicates sustained pressure. The predictive spill mitigator uses the access histogram to rank candidate segments by short-term read/write intensity and expected reclaimability, preferring to consolidate cold segments before spilling hot-but-fragmented segments. We also add an opportunistic micro-consolidation pass that runs inline with normal eviction and is budgeted to the current serving kernel to avoid CPU interference.

Interactions with batching and scheduler: To avoid increasing serving latency, the micro-consolidation work is throttled by a scheduler token bucket that ties its budget to observed continuous-batching latency SLOs. When batching pressure is high (lots of small sequences), consolidation backoff is enforced and we rely on hysteresis to avoid reactive spill storms. The change includes a kernel hint API so the planner can deprioritize consolidation on latency-sensitive kernels and favor it on background kernels.

Implementation notes: - new modules: kv/shadow_reservoir.*, kv/predictive_spill.*, kv/consolidator_worker.* - kept the public eviction API stable; behavior is opt-in via config flags (default enabled in main builds after canary). - metrics: added kv.shadow_pressure, kv.spill_candidates_ranked, kv.consolidation_time_ms (p80/p95). - telemetry tags are tenant-aware for downstream cost attribution.

Testing and validation: single-node microbenchmarks (mix of 80/10/10 hot/warm/cold key distributions) show a 28% reduction in spill events, 18% lower fragmentation score (measured by live-region-coalescence metric), and 7-11% lower 99th-percentile token latency under mixed-tenancy stress compared to baseline. Cluster canary runs (3x machines, region eu-west-1) observed stable tail latencies and no increase in CPU beyond a 3% median. Load tests include synthetic tenant bursts and real-production trace replay for 1 hour.

Risk and rollout plan: staged rollout via feature flag + tenant whitelist. Initial canary in eu-west-1 with 10% traffic, monitor kv.shadow_pressure and spill rates for 48h, then expand. In case of regressions the system falls back to the previous eviction path (config toggle) and aborts consolidation jobs.

Checklist: - [x] design doc linked in Linear (ENG-4512) - [x] unit tests for histogram decay and scoring logic - [x] integration tests with eviction simulation harness - [x] canary run and perf numbers collected - [x] metrics wired to console dashboards

Notes: This is intentionally conservative in CPU usage; consolidation is small and idempotent. Future follow-ups planned: tenant-aware global compaction scheduler and optional background rewriter that operates off-peak to perform larger defragmentation sweeps.

release_notes: Introduce a shadow-reservation based hysteresis and predictive spill ranking to reduce KV spill churn, lower fragmentation, and smooth eviction behaviour under mixed-tenant workloads. Enabled behind feature flag; opt-out per-tenant. Improves spill event rate and 99p latency in mixed workloads.
notes_for_releng: Requires metrics consumer to include new kv.shadow_pressure and kv.consolidation_time_ms. Add config toggles to tenant config template. Can be toggled off via tenant config key: kv.consolidation.enabled=false

backout_plan: Flip feature flag off and drain consolidator worker via graceful shutdown; evictor logic reverts to baseline. Automated rollback script located in deploy/scripts/rollback_kv_shadow.sh
